### Summary

Robotics PhD candidate in Dr. Samuel Coogan's FACTS Lab at Georgia Tech and AI for Autonomy intern at Sandia National Laboratories, specializing in safe autonomy, reinforcement learning, and real-time control. Proven track record of developing and deploying safe, computationally efficient planning and control methods for autonomous systems. Selected to the U.S. Department of State's Fulbright Specialist Roster after spearheading an international research collaboration with Lactec, a Brazilian partner institution, that is bringing research funding to Georgia Tech. Author of 4 peer-reviewed publications, with 3 more under review.
